summary: The public-repository pre-push check no longer rescans already published history when it updates an existing branch. Commits already reachable from the remote's branches are excluded from the scan.

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes; the check still rejects the same findings in new commits.

compatibility.detail: Development tooling only; no runtime or wire changes.

downtime.detail: No migration or downtime is required.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous scan range.
